mechanismOfAction.summary: NMDA receptor antagonist (arylcyclohexylamine class); ethyl-substituted N-substituent vs piperidine ring of 3-Me-PCP.
mechanismOfAction.description: N-ethyl-substituted arylcyclohexylamine with 3-methyl phenyl ring substitution. NMDA antagonism confirmed by Wallach et al. 2015. Secondary pharmacology unstudied. First reported to EUDA March 2024. Structurally distinct from 3-MeO-PCE — do not transfer doses. Same arylcyclohexylamine risk profile as 3-Me-PCP.
